# Nastaliq

> Nastaliq LLP builds and hosts private cloud ERP for growing businesses in North America: inventory, purchasing, sales and accounting in one system, with each client on its own dedicated server, in the language your team works in. Cloud only. Pricing is a flat monthly subscription with unlimited users plus a one-time implementation fee, sent by email. Data migration is charged separately.

Nastaliq LLP is incorporated with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) and based in Lahore, Pakistan. Contact: hello@nastaliq.co

## Products
- [Business suite](https://nastaliq.co/products#suite): Inventory, purchasing, accounting and sales in one cloud system, implemented for your business and hosted by us.
- [Janitorial operations](https://nastaliq.co/products#janitorial): Run a commercial cleaning company from one app, for cleaners, supervisors and clients.
- [Owner dashboard and alerts](https://nastaliq.co/products#owner): A home screen by role, phone-friendly stock screens, and a morning email digest of what needs attention.
- [Every language](https://nastaliq.co/products#languages): Each user picks their own language on every screen, and documents print in the language your customer reads.
- [Point of sale](https://nastaliq.co/products#pos): A clean, fast till for restaurants, fast food and bakeries.

## Industries
- [ERP for distribution and wholesale companies](https://nastaliq.co/industries/distribution): Purchasing, receiving, stock and customer pricing in one private cloud system, implemented for distribution and hosted by us.
- [ERP for retail businesses](https://nastaliq.co/industries/retail): Stock, purchasing, sales records and accounting in one private cloud system, implemented for retail and hosted by us.
- [ERP for manufacturing companies](https://nastaliq.co/industries/manufacturing): Bills of materials, work orders, purchasing and stock in one private cloud system, with the books following every job.
- [ERP for food and beverage companies](https://nastaliq.co/industries/food-and-beverage): Stock, purchasing, sales and accounting for food and drink producers and wholesalers, with batch and expiry tracking.
- [ERP for construction and trades businesses](https://nastaliq.co/industries/construction): Projects, purchasing, timesheets and invoicing in one private cloud system for contractors and trades businesses.
- [ERP for professional services firms](https://nastaliq.co/industries/professional-services): Timesheets, projects, billing and accounting in one private cloud system for agencies, consultancies and firms that sell time.
- [ERP for e-commerce businesses](https://nastaliq.co/industries/ecommerce): Stock, purchasing, orders and accounting behind your online store, in one private cloud system.
- [Operations software for commercial cleaning companies](https://nastaliq.co/industries/janitorial): Crews, inspections, clients and supplies in one app, for cleaners, supervisors and the companies you serve.

## Frequently asked questions
**What is Nastaliq?** Nastaliq is a private cloud ERP for growing businesses in North America, typically companies with $1M or more in annual revenue. It puts inventory, purchasing, sales and accounting in one system, on your own dedicated server, in the language your team works in. We implement it for your business and host it.

**Is our data shared with other clients?** No. Every client, whatever its size, runs on its own dedicated server with its own site. Your system and data are not shared with any other company.

**How much does Nastaliq cost?** Pricing is a flat monthly subscription with unlimited users, plus a one-time implementation fee. Data migration is charged separately. We send the exact plan and price by email after you tell us what you run.

**Do I need to install anything?** No. Nastaliq runs in the cloud. You sign in from a browser or your phone.

**Does Nastaliq support my language?** Yes. Every screen can be switched to the language your team works in, each user picks their own, and documents print in the language your customer reads.

**Can you bring my existing records in?** Yes, as a paid add-on. Data migration is not part of the implementation fee. Tell us what you use today and we will say what is possible and what it costs.
